cuad_consulting.summary: Gunston Consulting, LLC provides independent consulting services to Medalist Diversified REIT, Inc., including managing the company’s affairs, under an agreement effective 2020-03-01. The initial term is 12 months and automatically renews for another 12 months unless terminated. Compensation is $200,000 annually plus stock grants awarded by the compensation committee. Either party may terminate on 90 days’ written notice; a qualifying termination after a change of control triggers a fee equal to 12 months’ compensation. Confidentiality, work product ownership and restrictive covenants apply, and Virginia law governs.

LLC (“CONSULTANT”), a Virginia limited liability company, and Medalist Diversified REIT, Inc. (“REIT” or the “Company”), a Maryland
corporation, collectively the “Parties.”

fb_ulta_q4.summary: Ulta Beauty reported fourth-quarter and fiscal 2022 results for the periods ended January 28, 2023. Fourth-quarter net sales rose 18.2% to $3.2 billion, and net income rose 17.8% to $340.8 million, or $6.68 per diluted share. Full-year sales rose 18.3% to $10.2 billion, with net income of $1.2 billion. For fiscal 2023, the company projected sales of $10.95 billion to $11.05 billion and diluted earnings per share of $24.70 to $25.40.
